title: Monotonicity of space bounds
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean symbols, and let $s,s'\colon\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$. If $N$ uses at most $s(|x|)$ space on every Boolean input $x$ and every choice word, and $s(n)\le s'(n)$ for every $n\in\mathbb{N}$, then $N$ uses at most $s'(|x|)$ space on every Boolean input and every choice word.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean symbols
$N$ uses space at most $s(|x|)$ for every input and choice word
